title: Fennel Pasta with Broccoli and Mint Butter
subtitle: with Parmesan
description: Slow-roasted fennel and short pasta tossed in a silky broccoli, mint and lemon puree enriched with butter and finished with Parmesan.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 170°C. Wrap the fennel in foil and bake for about 2 hours until completely soft. Cool and cut into quarters.
Blanch the broccoli florets in boiling water for a few seconds, transfer to iced water and drain. Blanch the mint the same way.
Blend the broccoli, mint, lemon juice and chilli in a food processor until smooth and transfer to a wide frying pan. Meanwhile cook the pasta according to the packet instructions.
Warm the broccoli puree over low heat (don't let it burn) and whisk in the soft butter one cube at a time.
Add the pasta and fennel to the pan, season with salt and white pepper, grate Parmesan over the top and serve straight from the pan.
